@matteinn Does this happen only on certain phones/os versions?

No, this is a problem with various Android OS versions(8/7/9/10) and different device manufacturers.

1. 40% in Android 8
2. 25% with Techno Mobile limited
@raghav2945 Do you have any idea roughly what frequency this is happening? Can you attach the animation that is crashing? Looking at the code, I don't see any clear reason this would be possible.

@matteinn Because this crash happens rarely, only on certain devices, and doesn't seem to be wide spread (I haven't gotten any other reports of this), I suggest using the safe mode APIs. They can be set via XML on LottieAnimationView or programmatically on LottieAnimationView or LottieDrawable.

This basically wraps the draw path in a try/catch for rare cases like this. It is almost never needed but may be the best course of action here.

body:
@gpeal where can I find the documentation about this "safe mode"? Is this a new feature about to be released?
From what I see in https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-android/pull/1939 it looks like no changes will be required on consumer apps, besides upgrading to the next SDK version which will contain that PR

@matteinn You can use 4.2.1-SNAPSHOT now or wait for the next patch release which should be coming out soon.
[This](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-android/blob/master/lottie/src/main/java/com/airbnb/lottie/LottieAnimationView.java#L1070) is the safeMode API.
